<!-- ===== 02 · THE PROBLEM WITH GENERIC AI ===== -->
<section class="tr-problem" data-screen-label="The Problem with Generic AI">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="tr-problem-grid">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow tr-eyebrow">The Case for Custom</span>
        <h2>Generic AI was built for everyone. <span class="ital">That&rsquo;s why it works perfectly for no one.</span></h2>
        <p>Every organisation has language, processes, and knowledge that no public training dataset contains. Generic LLMs hallucinate when faced with domain-specific queries because they&rsquo;ve never encountered your clinical terminology, your care protocols, or your internal escalation workflows. Fine-tuning changes that.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="tr-compare" role="table" aria-label="Generic AI versus Kleza-trained AI">
        <div class="tr-chead" role="row"><span class="c gen" role="columnheader">Generic AI</span><span class="c kl" role="columnheader">Kleza-trained AI</span></div>
        <div class="tr-crow"><div class="tr-cval gen">Trained on public internet</div><div class="tr-cval kl"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg><span>Trained on your data</span></div></div><div class="tr-crow"><div class="tr-cval gen">Approximate domain knowledge</div><div class="tr-cval kl"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg><span>Precise context awareness</span></div></div><div class="tr-crow"><div class="tr-cval gen">High hallucination risk on specialised tasks</div><div class="tr-cval kl"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg><span>Validated accuracy benchmarks</span></div></div><div class="tr-crow"><div class="tr-cval gen">Same for every organisation</div><div class="tr-cval kl"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg><span>Specific to your operations</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== 05 · TRAINING PROCESS ===== -->
<section class="tr-proc" id="process" data-screen-label="Training Process">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="head">
      <span class="eyebrow tr-eyebrow">The Process</span>
      <h2 class="tr-h2">How we build <span class="ital">your custom AI model.</span></h2>
    </div>
    <div class="tr-timeline" id="trTimeline"><div class="tr-tl-step tr-reveal"><div class="tr-tl-num">01</div><div class="tr-tl-body"><h4>Data Discovery</h4><p>We audit your available data sources, assess quality, identify gaps, and flag compliance requirements before any processing begins.</p></div></div><div class="tr-tl-step tr-reveal"><div class="tr-tl-num">02</div><div class="tr-tl-body"><h4>Data Preparation</h4><p>Cleaning, formatting, de-identification (for healthcare), and structuring data into training-ready formats.</p></div></div><div class="tr-tl-step tr-reveal"><div class="tr-tl-num">03</div><div class="tr-tl-body"><h4>Architecture Selection</h4><p>We select the right base model and training approach &mdash; fine-tuning, RAG, or a combination &mdash; for your specific use case.</p></div></div><div class="tr-tl-step tr-reveal"><div class="tr-tl-num">04</div><div class="tr-tl-body"><h4>Training &amp; Iteration</h4><p>Model training runs with iterative refinement. Domain experts review outputs at key checkpoints.</p></div></div><div class="tr-tl-step tr-reveal"><div class="tr-tl-num">05</div><div class="tr-tl-body"><h4>Evaluation &amp; Benchmarking</h4><p>Accuracy, relevance, and hallucination rate benchmarked against agreed success criteria before any deployment.</p></div></div><div class="tr-tl-step tr-reveal"><div class="tr-tl-num">06</div><div class="tr-tl-body"><h4>Deployment &amp; Monitoring</h4><p>Production deployment with ongoing accuracy monitoring, scheduled retraining cycles, and performance reporting.</p></div></div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== 07 · CASE STUDY ===== -->
<section class="tr-case" data-screen-label="Case Study">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="head">
      <span class="eyebrow tr-eyebrow">Case Study</span>
      <h2 class="tr-h2">From 2-week onboarding to 4 days &mdash; <span class="ital">with AI that knew the job already.</span></h2>
    </div>
    <div class="tr-case-card">
      <div class="tr-case-left">
        <div class="tr-case-metric">4 days</div>
        <p class="tr-case-mlabel">Onboarding time post-deployment, down from 14 days prior.</p>
        <div class="tr-case-client">Client &mdash; CaReBridge</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tr-case-right">
        <div class="tr-case-block"><div class="lab">Challenge</div><p>New caregiver onboarding took 2 weeks because training materials were scattered across documents and institutional knowledge held by senior staff.</p></div>
        <div class="tr-case-block"><div class="lab">Approach</div><p>Kleza trained a custom knowledge assistant on all training materials, SOPs, and recorded Q&amp;A from senior staff. Deployed as a conversational assistant accessible via the onboarding app.</p></div>
        <div class="tr-case-block outcome"><div class="lab">Outcome</div><p>Onboarding time reduced from 14 days to 4. New caregivers rated the assistant 4.8/5 for accuracy. Senior staff time freed from repetitive questions.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== 08 · FAQ ===== -->
<section class="tr-faq-sec" data-screen-label="FAQ">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="tr-faq-head"><span class="eyebrow tr-eyebrow">FAQ</span><h2 class="tr-h2">Questions about <span class="ital">AI training.</span></h2></div>
    <div class="tr-faq" id="trFaq"><div class="tr-faq-item"><button class="tr-faq-q">What is LLM fine-tuning and why does my business need it?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="tr-faq-a"><p>LLM fine-tuning is the process of training a large language model on your specific data &mdash; so it learns your terminology, workflows, and context rather than relying on generic public training data. The result is AI that answers domain-specific questions accurately instead of hallucinating plausible-sounding but incorrect responses.</p></div></div><div class="tr-faq-item"><button class="tr-faq-q">What data do I need to start AI training?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="tr-faq-a"><p>The ideal starting dataset includes operational documentation (SOPs, training materials), communication records, and any structured data your team produces regularly. Kleza conducts a data discovery audit first &mdash; we will tell you whether your existing data is sufficient and what gaps exist before any commitment.</p></div></div><div class="tr-faq-item"><button class="tr-faq-q">How do you handle sensitive healthcare data during training?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="tr-faq-a"><p>All healthcare data is processed under signed Data Processing Agreements and HIPAA-compliant protocols. We de-identify patient data before any training use, use secure isolated environments for training runs, and provide full data handling documentation on request.</p></div></div><div class="tr-faq-item"><button class="tr-faq-q">How long does it take to build and deploy a custom AI model?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="tr-faq-a"><p>A focused AI assistant typically deploys in 6-10 weeks from data discovery to go-live. Full LLM fine-tuning projects range from 8-16 weeks depending on data complexity and evaluation requirements.</p></div></div><div class="tr-faq-item"><button class="tr-faq-q">Can Kleza combine AI training with the AI Support Assistant service?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="tr-faq-a"><p>Yes &mdash; and this combination produces the strongest outcomes. An AI assistant built on a model trained with your data generates more accurate, context-aware responses than one using a generic base model. Ask about our combined AI packages.</p></div></div></div>
  </div>
</section>
